meta.note: First real verified facility dataset — Yola/Jimeta, Adamawa State, Nigeria. Coordinates and identities sourced from OpenStreetMap (element-level references in each record's source string) and corroborated where possible by official/institutional sources. No phone number or opening-hours value is included unless independently confirmed; fields are omitted rather than guessed. verified:true means the record passed the project data-verification process (docs/DATASET-CONTRACT.md) — it is NOT a clinical endorsement by Lifeguard360.

facilities.name: Modibbo Adama University Teaching Hospital
facilities.openingHours: Emergency services 24/7; visiting hours 4-6 PM daily
facilities.address: Abuja Road, Yola, Yola North, Adamawa State, Nigeria
facilities.source: OpenStreetMap way/1288856908 (9.1936627,12.4914568) and node/13860924598 (Abuja Road, Yola), retrieved and verified 2026-09-17; official hospital website mauth.gov.ng — identity, contact line 08036516745 and 24/7 emergency/visiting hours confirmed; website content verified 2026-09-17; Wikipedia 'Federal Medical Centre, Yola' (en.wikipedia.org) documents the December 2024 upgrade from FMC Yola to Modibbo Adama University Teaching Hospital. Coordinates from the Nominatim-confirmed OSM node; way-center differs by ~100 m (campus polygon vs entrance). Address (Abuja Road, Yola North) from the same Nominatim-confirmed OSM node, retrieved and verified 2026-09-17.
